nodes.meaning: Current manual wake did not grant native write admission
nodes.limitations: Expected bridge node mapped from exact source; native fixture records its own refusal, not a real OS recovery

nodes.meaning: Host Ready status must still pass shared native admission; no additional control may be issued after refusal
simulation: Six original authenticated HTTP request timelines
nodes.limitations: Ready/noop is not permission by itself; compare subsequent open/acquire/enable client sends

nodes.meaning: OFF, newer power or newer explicit intent retires the pending continuation
simulation: Original manual continuation newest curve/preset cases
nodes.limitations: A pre-boundary request may finish late; distinguish it from a new request issued after the rejection. Same-generation newer wake may admit only the fresh valid intent.
